verdict.rationale: vLLM's own CLI reference documents a command that starts the OpenAI-compatible API server (`vllm serve`), so the start half of the story is directly covered. The evidence never describes a stop or shutdown command or a graceful-termination workflow. Missing for 10: documented CLI stop/shutdown of the server, independent or hands-on corroboration of the start/stop lifecycle.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
The vllm serve CLI reference documents the flag pair --disable-fastapi-docs / --enable-fastapi-docs
